description: This Java source file defines AcceptAnyTrustManager, a TrustManager implementation that accepts any SSL certificate without validation, intended for local development and testing purposes.

classes.name: AcceptAnyTrustManager
classes.description: A TrustManager that accepts any SSL certificate. Implements X509TrustManager. Contains a static factory method to create a TrustManagerFactory that supplies this TrustManager.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates a TrustManagerFactory that supplies an instance of AcceptAnyTrustManager.

methods.name: getAcceptedIssuers
methods.description: Returns an empty array, indicating no particular accepted certificate issuers.

methods.name: checkClientTrusted
methods.description: No-op method that skips client certificate trust checking.

methods.name: checkServerTrusted
methods.description: No-op method that skips server certificate trust checking.
